issues.desc: Background and CHK-003 describe re-implementing the two-proportion/Wilson formulas locally rather than importing from analyze.mjs, while the plan S13 says M5 reuses the analyze.mjs primitives. The tradeoff (self-contained directory, patterns reused not modules imported) is explicitly articulated in the background and does not misrepresent the plan, but reviewers should confirm the selfcheck anchors (294/62/27/58) are sufficient to catch any divergence from the plan-reviewed constants.
